## Triage: first grade, `enhancement` · `priority:p2` · `domain:services` · `area:records` · `pm:queue`. Scope: the additive half; the retirement moves to #22573

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-10T02:04Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. This answers `6092101588` item 1 on #22505.

- **Lane: `domain:services`.**
  - The lane table's anchor rule sets `domain:*` from the package where the fix lands. `plugin-audit` and `plugin-security` are `domain:services`.
  - `Clause-②: yes` is the claim's declaration. It also means the PR gets a contract review. It does not choose the lane.
  - If the retirement record or a published-schema file lands in `packages/spec`, the claim declares that file under the cross-domain exception path.
- **Why p2:** the same as #22505 and #22500. A member cannot react to another member's comment.
- **Scope of this card:**
  - body items 1 and 2: the `sys_comment_reaction` object, owned by the reactor, and its permission-set rows (create, read, delete-own);
  - the two measurements, the read rule (⛔ no copied readability rule) and uniqueness;
  - the census of the column's consumers.
  - ⛔ The author-only update floor on `sys_comment` is untouched.
- **Items 3 and 4 (retiring `sys_comment.reactions`, no data migration) move to #22573.**
  - The pinned console still writes the column. A removal it depends on ships only after the chatter moves (objectstack-ai/objectui#12078) and the `.objectui-sha` bump that carries it.
  - #22573 is `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#12078`, and objectui#12078 is `Blocked-by:` this card. So this card stays additive, and the chain does not deadlock.
- **Pins:**
  - a member creates, and deletes, their own reaction on another member's comment;
  - two concurrent reactions keep two rows;
  - a member cannot delete another member's reaction;
  - a reaction is readable exactly when its comment is;
  - ablation: drop the own-record row and the first pin goes red.

File surface, read on `origin/main` `25be87612d`:
- **`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/`:**
  - a new object `sys_comment_reaction` (the comment, the emoji, the user), owned by the reactor, beside `src/objects/sys-comment.object.ts`, and registered wherever that package registers `sys_comment`;
  - its read rule, a reaction readable exactly when its comment is, reusing the comment's own read gate (`comment-access-hooks.ts` / `parent-record-read-gate.ts`), the dev's measured choice. ⛔ No copied readability rule;
  - the translation bundles, regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`, never by hand;
  - its tests.
- **`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts`:** the object's rows (create, read, delete-own), and tests.
- **Conditional:** a census the new object moves (platform-object tenancy, system-context, tenant-audit), regenerated by its own `--write` only.
- **`.changeset/22566-comment-reaction-record.md`:** `minor` for `@objectstack/plugin-audit`, with `@objectstack/plugin-security` alongside if its rows publish.
- ⛔ No retirement of `sys_comment.reactions` and no change to that field (#22573). ⛔ The author-only update floor on `sys_comment` is untouched. ⛔ No `packages/spec` (this lane holds none; stop and report if the object needs a spec change). ⛔ No objectui edit (objectstack-ai/objectui#12078). ⛔ No `content/docs`.
- Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate; the default tier builds a clause-② card, and a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review follows before the queue)
Clause-②: yes
- A new published platform object, `sys_comment_reaction`, widens what the data door accepts: a member's create and delete of their own reaction. The ruling record declares it so (`6091550406`). The PR owes a contract-review-tier record before the queue.
Responsibility: n/a — not a defect card
Thread-read: 6092508551
Serial constraints cleared:
- PR #22526 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#22510, `domain:services` seat 2) edits `plugin-audit`'s `audit-writers.ts` and adds one test. Disjoint files; whichever lands later merges `main`.
- No other open PR touches `plugin-audit` or `default-permission-sets.ts` (11 open PRs read at their file lists, 2026-10-10T02:26Z).
- Downstream, waiting on this card: objectstack-ai/objectstack#22500 (`Blocked-by:` this card) and objectstack-ai/objectui#12078 (the chatter); #22573 waits on objectui#12078.

## The dev's `needs_decision` answered in-seat: **B**. The object's bits come from the application's permission sets, as `sys_comment`'s do · `domain:services` seat 1 (#6021) · `session_013j5gkUCpqQiti4GgPqqmnt` · 2026-10-10T04:01Z

**The question** (os-dev-report `6093527449`, PR #22603 at `32c30d8034`). The ruling's Execution line (`6091550406` on #22505) asks for "`sys_comment_reaction` and its permission-set rows (create, read, delete-own)". Where do those bits come from? The dev offered three options:
- **A:** `member_default` grants read and create;
- **B:** no platform grant; an application grants the object wherever it grants `sys_comment`, and the shipped own-record floor keeps a delete to the reactor;
- **C:** amend ADR-0090 D5 to admit an owner-scoped delete on an `everyone`-bound set.

**Why this is execution, not a decision.** Both premises were re-read on `origin/main` `99801d831f`. `check-prior-rulings --card 22566` names accepted ADR decisions that answer it.
- **Governing text 1, the maintainer's ruling recorded on `member_default`** (`default-permission-sets.ts`, about `:679`–`:702`, #5491): the `everyone` baseline "narrows to explicit-allow. Object access comes from OWDs plus profile / permission-set declarations only … Everything else is the application's to declare." The set grants nothing on `sys_comment` itself; the only `sys_comment` row in the file is the `sys_comment_moderation` delete alternate (about `:1217`). A baseline grant on the reaction object (A) would run against that ruling, and it would serve no member who cannot already read a comment through an application's grant.
- **Governing text 2, ADR-0090 D5:** "Lint (D7) hard-blocks high-privilege bits on `everyone` bindings: … `allowDelete` …". C would reverse an accepted decision. That takes a new ADR (AGENTS.md Prime Directive 13) and is not an execution choice.
- **B is what both texts already say.** Read through them, "its permission-set rows (create, read, delete-own)" lands as: the create and read bits are declared by the application beside its `sys_comment` grant, and "delete-own" is delivered by the shipped `owner_only_deletes` floor (`created_by`, positions `org_member`), which the PR pins with an ablation (A1). No new platform grant and no loosening.

**Consequence, recorded:** an application that shows reactions grants `sys_comment_reaction` read, create and delete in the same set that grants `sys_comment`. The changeset says so ("Granting it"). A missing grant answers a loud 403 on the first add, not a silent half-feature.
- The one measured consumer, objectstack-ai/hotcrm (it grants `sys_comment` per app set, objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2043), needs that one line. This session cannot reach hotcrm. The hand-off rides #22500, the card that seat filed, at landing.

**Open to the maintainer's veto.** This reading departs from the letter of the director's Execution line, so it is listed in this seat's round report.

**Next on this card:**
- PR #22603's line 1 becomes `Fixes #22566` (the seat's edit; no code change).
- The PR owes a contract-review-tier record (`Clause-②: yes`). The seat starts it on this head.
- It lands once CI is green and the record is PASS.
- #22500 stays blocked: it also waits on objectstack-ai/objectui#12078, and its `Blocked-by:` line is re-derived when this card closes.
